name: myworth-root
description: Root orchestrator for MyWorth local net worth tracker

scripts.install-all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install --legacy-peer-deps
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "backend,frontend" -c "yellow,cyan" "npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
scripts.start: npx concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "backend,frontend" -c "yellow,cyan" "npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
scripts.build: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
